sections.en:
1 On Tâbit ben Qorra, cf. above, p. 88, n. 4. The Book of Images or On Astronomical Images is preserved in the codices. Perhaps it is the same book On Three Magical Figures published at Frankfurt in 1559; cf. Steinschneider, loc. cit., p. 387 c.
2 The Work on Images attributed to Ptolemy exists in the codices; cf. Steinschneider, loc. cit., p. 384 g; Boll, Sphaera, p. 391, 2.

summary.headline: Necromantic and Illicit Books
summary.text: Discussion of astronomical image books attributed to Tâbit ben Chorach and Ptolemy, followed by Chapter XVII on necromantic and illicit books. The chapter advises preserving such works for occasional consultation while warning against abuse, and classifies geomancy, hydromancy, aerimancy, pyromancy, and chiromancy as dubious experimental practices resembling idolatry.
